title: Linux Foundation announces formation of Agentic AI Foundation
attributed_claim_summary: Linux Foundation announced an Agentic AI Foundation with MCP, goose and AGENTS.md among initial contributed projects.
evidence_or_event: Claims are attributed to the original publisher; no original study results produced here.
limitations: Foundation formation and declared neutrality are governance events, not proof of implementation interoperability or global uptake.
research_relevance: AI-era coding methods, independently accepted functionality, OSS reuse and lifecycle cost
practical_experiment: Keep instructions and tool interfaces portable; measure cross-agent reproducibility and failure modes.
